title: LIONS OF ZION Anti-Israel Narrative Matrix Corpus
editorialNote: This corpus is a visual monitoring stream, not a list of standalone factual assertions. Explicitly debunked items are sourced and labeled FALSE CLAIM or MISINFORMATION. Broader political and legal narratives are labeled as monitored narratives and are not automatically declared false. Public people and organizations appear only with documented context from the listed sources.

colorLegend.red: hostile narrative, viral false claim, fabricated headline, or denial narrative
colorLegend.amber: public amplifier, emerging claim cluster, source under review, or network signal
colorLegend.blue: fact check, correction, verified context, or debunk result
colorLegend.neutral: hashtag, platform, source type, or general monitored term
